description: gosec's policy, read by -conf from .github/workflows/gosec.yml, which also carries the
two exclusions and the reasons for them. This file holds what only a configuration can
say: the file modes the runner is allowed to write. It writes artifacts into a git
checkout, and git records one executable bit and nothing else, so a 0600 file written
here is a 0644 file on every other clone; the modes below are the ones git produces,
and gosec fires on anything looser. The key is the rule, the value the widest mode
G301 is a directory, G302 a chmod, G306 a file written with WriteFile.
